changelog: Letterboxd, built in: each person links their own account under Settings > Profile, and every film they watch to the end is logged to their diary (rewatches marked, days already logged skipped), with an import of past watches. The admin page sets the Letterboxd API pair (or HERATV_LETTERBOXD_API_KEY and _SECRET). New settings: who sees the request quality capsule, which quality it starts on, and the exact Radarr and Sonarr profiles for 1080p and 4K (a 4K server makes a 4K request); how far ahead Leaving Soon looks; a switch per seasonal set; and, per person under Settings > Playback, post-play and its trailers. Certificates and streaming collections follow the configured region.
